item.title: Shipping Exposes Inefficiencies in Warehousing
item.description: When a commercial shipping route slows down, stretches transit times, or faces unexpected disruption, attention usually turns to ports, vessels, or freight rates, writes Ashley Rodriguez of Bins4Less.
